title: EV range gauge and EV ownership disappointment
summary: Reviews in this topic center on EV ownership impressions, with clear complaints about inaccurate range displays alongside several fragments that mention EVs or disappointment without enough context to assign a definite stance on the specific issue.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the EV experience can feel very good for a first-time owner.
